'''Kirkun''' was a soldier from [[Saldaea]] under [[Davram Bashere]]'s command.

== Activities ==
Kirkun followed Bashere to [[Algarin Pendaloan]]'s manor in [[Tear]], where they met up with [[Rand al'Thor]]. He died in the [[Trolloc]] attack against the manor.
